config.auto_shulker_inventory.title: Auto Shulker Inventory Settings
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_aut: Automatically stores items in shulker boxes when inventory is full
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_shi: Stores items in shulker boxes when shift-clicking in containers
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_cur: Prioritize storing items in the shulker box held by cursor (Priority 1)
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_con: Store items in shulker boxes inside opened containers (Priority 2)
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_inv: Use shulker boxes in player inventory as last resort (Priority 3)
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_cha: Show chat messages when items are auto-stored
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_sou: Play sound when items are stored in shulker boxes
config.auto_shulker_inventory.enable_vis: Show particle effects when items are auto-stored
config.auto_shulker_inventory.particle_s: Choose which particle effect to display
config.auto_shulker_inventory.storage_de: Delay before auto-storing items (0 = instant, 20 = 1 second)
message.auto_shulker_inventory.no_space: No space available in shulker boxes
